name: Can water-damaged drywall texture be repaired?

mainEntity.name: Can water-damaged drywall texture be repaired?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, water-damaged drywall texture can often be repaired, but the first critical step is to address and fix the source of the water leak to prevent future damage. Once the leak is resolved, any mold or mildew must be safely removed, and the affected drywall cut out. New drywall is then installed, mudded, textured, primed, and painted. It's crucial to ensure the area is completely dry before beginning repairs to avoid trapping moisture and encouraging further issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Water-damaged drywall texture can be repaired after the leak source is fixed, mold removed, and affected drywall replaced. The area must be completely dry before repair.
